meta.title: এটি কীভাবে কাজ করে
meta.description: একটি প্রশ্ন কীভাবে উত্তরে পরিণত হয়, কেন উৎসগুলি মনে রাখার পরিবর্তে পুনরুদ্ধার করা হয়, এবং কখন সিস্টেম উত্তর দিতে অস্বীকার করে।

heading: একটি প্রশ্ন কীভাবে উদ্ধৃত উত্তরে পরিণত হয়
standfirst: একটি প্রশ্ন কীভাবে উৎস-সহ উত্তরে পরিণত হয়, এবং অনুমান না করে সিস্টেম কখন উত্তর দিতে অস্বীকার করে।

status.heading: প্রকৃতপক্ষে কী নির্মিত হয়েছে
status.body: প্রতিটি উত্তর যাচাই করা আনুষ্ঠানিক উৎস থেকে তৈরি — উৎস পৃষ্ঠায় তালিকাভুক্ত আইন, বিধি, নির্দেশিকা ও সরকারি পোর্টাল — এবং প্রতিটি দাবি তার উৎসের সঙ্গে যুক্ত।

pipeline.heading: একটি প্রশ্নের ক্ষেত্রে কী ঘটে
pipeline.standfirst: তেরোটি পর্যায়। এটি কী করে তা দেখতে একটি নির্বাচন করুন।

detect.name: ভাষা শনাক্তকরণ
detect.does: (ভাষা শনাক্তকরণ) Works out which of the six supported languages the question is in, with a confidence score.
detect.outputs: (ভাষা শনাক্তকরণ) A language code and a confidence, both shown in the interface so the reader can correct them.
detect.fails: (ভাষা শনাক্তকরণ) A wrong guess is visible and correctable rather than silent. Below a confidence floor it asks instead of guessing.

understand.name: প্রশ্ন অনুধাবন
understand.does: (প্রশ্ন অনুধাবন) Extracts what is being asked: intent, which rights are in play, which regulatory areas, hints about the product class, and named entities such as herbs, dosage forms and destination markets.
understand.outputs: (প্রশ্ন অনুধাবন) A structured query, plus a decision on whether the question can be answered at all without more facts.
understand.fails: (প্রশ্ন অনুধাবন) An ambiguous question routes to a clarifying question rather than to a confident answer about the wrong thing.

clarify.name: স্পষ্টীকরণ
clarify.does: (স্পষ্টীকরণ) Where the answer depends on what the product is regulatorily and that is not yet known, asks the single most decisive question rather than answering for every possibility.
clarify.outputs: (স্পষ্টীকরণ) Either a product class, or an explicit statement that the answer is conditional on it.
clarify.fails: (স্পষ্টীকরণ) If the reader declines to answer, the system says which way the answer would turn rather than picking one.

route.name: এখতিয়ার বিভাজন
route.does: (এখতিয়ার বিভাজন) Selects the namespace to search. India and International are separate indexes, and a single retrieval call reads one of them.
route.outputs: (এখতিয়ার বিভাজন) A namespace, or two retrievals for a cross-border question.
route.fails: (এখতিয়ার বিভাজন) There is no fallback that merges the two. A question that cannot be routed is asked which jurisdiction it means.

retrieve.name: পুনরুদ্ধার
retrieve.does: (পুনরুদ্ধার) Hybrid search over the selected namespace: keyword matching and dense vectors, fused. Metadata filters are applied before scoring — jurisdiction, effective date window, document type, product class and topic — so superseded text is never a candidate.
retrieve.outputs: (পুনরুদ্ধার) A candidate set of passages with their scores and metadata.
retrieve.fails: (পুনরুদ্ধার) Below a retrieval floor there is nothing to answer from, and the pipeline goes to abstention rather than to generation.

rerank.name: পুনঃক্রমবিন্যাস
rerank.does: (পুনঃক্রমবিন্যাস) A cross-encoder reads each candidate against the question and reorders them, cutting a broad candidate set down to the few that actually bear on it.
rerank.outputs: (পুনঃক্রমবিন্যাস) A short ranked list, carrying both the retrieval score and the rerank score.
rerank.fails: (পুনঃক্রমবিন্যাস) If nothing clears the rerank threshold, that is itself a signal, and confidence drops or the system abstains.

context.name: প্রসঙ্গ সমাবেশ
context.does: (প্রসঙ্গ সমাবেশ) Packs the chosen passages with their metadata headers — title, section path, version, effective date — so the model can attribute what it uses. The token budget is enforced with document diversity, so the window is never filled from a single document.
context.outputs: (প্রসঙ্গ সমাবেশ) A context block where every passage is addressable by id.
context.fails: (প্রসঙ্গ সমাবেশ) If diversity cannot be met, the answer is marked as resting on a single source, which caps its confidence.

generate.name: উত্তর তৈরি
generate.does: (উত্তর তৈরি) Answers from the provided passages and nothing else, under a prompt that forbids stating anything not present in them. Output is schema-constrained: the four blocks, plus a machine-readable map from each claim to the passages supporting it.
generate.outputs: (উত্তর তৈরি) Structured blocks and a claim-to-passage map, never prose to be parsed afterwards.
generate.fails: (উত্তর তৈরি) If the passages do not support an answer, the model is required to return an abstention object rather than its best guess.

map.name: উদ্ধৃতি ম্যাপিং
map.does: (উদ্ধৃতি ম্যাপিং) Checks every passage id the model returned against the passages actually supplied. Any claim whose citation does not verify is dropped.
map.outputs: (উদ্ধৃতি ম্যাপিং) An answer where every marker resolves to a real retrieved passage.
map.fails: (উদ্ধৃতি ম্যাপিং) If too many claims drop, the answer is downgraded or abstains. An uncited answer is never shown in place of a cited one.

confidence.name: আস্থা মূল্যায়ন
confidence.does: (আস্থা মূল্যায়ন) Computes high, moderate, low or abstain from the retrieval result — how many passages cleared the threshold, how many distinct documents they came from, whether they contradict each other, and whether they are all within their effective window.
confidence.outputs: (আস্থা মূল্যায়ন) A level and a one-sentence reason, both shown.
confidence.fails: (আস্থা মূল্যায়ন) Records never raise or lower it. Confidence is a property of the sources, not of how the answer reads.

abstain.name: বিরত থাকার পরীক্ষা
abstain.does: (বিরত থাকার পরীক্ষা) The last gate before an answer is shown. Decides whether the question was out of scope, whether the sources conflict, whether they are out of date, or whether nothing relevant was found.
abstain.outputs: (বিরত থাকার পরীক্ষা) Either an answer, or one of the abstention states below with what the reader is offered next.
abstain.fails: (বিরত থাকার পরীক্ষা) This is the stage that is allowed to fail loudly. Abstaining is a correct outcome, not an error.

translate.name: অনুবাদ
translate.does: (অনুবাদ) Translates the answer into the reader's language, behind an interface so the implementation can be swapped — including for national language infrastructure.
translate.outputs: (অনুবাদ) A translated answer with untranslated citation metadata.
translate.fails: (অনুবাদ) Source passages are never translated. A translated citation is no longer a citation, and a reader checking a source needs the words as published.

render.name: উত্তর প্রদর্শন
render.does: (উত্তর প্রদর্শন) Renders the four blocks with claim-level markers, the confidence and its reason, and the source cards behind them. Sentences resting on no passage are marked as general explanation.
render.outputs: What you see on the workspace.
render.fails: (উত্তর প্রদর্শন) If citation mapping produced nothing to show, this surface renders an abstention rather than an unsourced answer.

retrieval.heading: উৎসগুলি কেন মনে রাখার পরিবর্তে পুনরুদ্ধার করা হয়
retrieval.body1: A language model asked a legal question from its training data answers from memory. That answer is undated, unattributed, and confidently wrong on anything that has been amended since the model was trained — which, in this field, is a great deal. It cannot tell you where it got something, because it does not know.
retrieval.body2: Retrieval changes what the model is allowed to use. The answer is constrained to a curated, version-tracked set of published documents, each claim points at the passage behind it, and every answer carries the date of the sources it used.
retrieval.body3: It reduces hallucination and localises it. It does not eliminate it. A model can still misread a passage, or state something the passage does not quite say. That is precisely why every claim is checkable against the passage it names, why sentences resting on nothing are marked as such, and why the system is built to abstain rather than to produce something plausible.

abstention.heading: উত্তর দিতে অস্বীকার করা একটি ইতিবাচক বৈশিষ্ট্য
abstention.standfirst: Most of the work in a product like this is in knowing when not to answer. These are the states, with what each one offers the reader next. The logic behind them is designed and not yet built; what you see here is the surface it will use.

nothing.title: Nothing relevant found
nothing.body: I couldn't find anything in these sources that answers this reliably.
nothing.offers: Rephrase, narrow the jurisdiction, name the product type, see what's covered, or send the question to a human with the context already filled in.

scope.title: Outside what this covers
scope.body: This is outside what I can answer. I cover intellectual property and regulatory requirements for Ayurvedic products — not clinical advice, individual legal opinions, or predictions about whether an application will succeed.
scope.offers: A plain statement of what it can do instead, and the escalation route.

conflict.title: The sources disagree
conflict.body: Two passages point different ways, and the answer depends on which governs.
conflict.offers: Both passages, with their dates and their documents, so the reader can see the disagreement rather than being handed one side of it.

stale.title: The sources may be out of date
stale.body: What was found sits outside its effective window, or predates an amendment the corpus knows about.
stale.offers: The passage with its date shown, and a plain statement that the position may have changed.

facts.title: It depends on facts you have not given
facts.body: The answer turns on something only you know — usually what the product is regulatorily.
facts.offers: The single most decisive question, rather than a list of every possibility.

jurisdictions.heading: দুটি নেমস্পেস, কখনো একত্রিত নয়
jurisdictions.body: India and International are separate indexes. A retrieval call reads one of them, and a cross-border question runs two retrievals and produces two answers rather than one blended paragraph. The reason is not tidiness: an answer that mixes the Indian position with an export market's is wrong in a way that reads as right, and a reader acting on it would not be able to tell which half applied to them.
jurisdictions.note: These two answers were produced separately and are shown side by side. Nothing in the product merges them, and no interface anywhere presents a single answer covering both.

architecture.heading: এটি কীভাবে তৈরি হয়েছে
architecture.standfirst: Layers, and what state each part is in. The retriever's metadata filters are listed because they are what makes superseded text unreachable rather than merely deprioritised.
architecture.filters: Jurisdiction · product class · IP right · regulatory area · effective date window · document type · language
architecture.notScheduledBody: A knowledge graph over entities and provisions, agentic orchestration across several sources for one question, and connectors to subscription databases. These are directions, not commitments, and none of them is being built.

evaluation.heading: এটি কীভাবে পরিমাপ করা হয়
evaluation.standfirst: These are the axes it will be scored on. Two of them have a target of one hundred per cent, because a single failure on either is the kind that destroys trust in everything else.
evaluation.notRunBody: There is no corpus to retrieve from and no pipeline to score, so there are no numbers on this page. When the harness runs it will write a summary that this page reads, and whatever it says will appear here — including the bad numbers. A page of metric definitions with no results is less impressive than a table of figures, and considerably more honest.

answerAccuracy.name: উত্তরের নির্ভুলতা
answerAccuracy.what: Whether the answer is right, judged against a reference answer and spot-checked by a person.
answerAccuracy.target: as high as the sources allow

citationCorrectness.name: উদ্ধৃতি নির্ভুলতা
citationCorrectness.what: Whether the passage a claim cites actually supports that claim.

citationValidity.name: উদ্ধৃতির বৈধতা
citationValidity.what: (উদ্ধৃতির বৈধতা) Whether every citation resolves to a real, current passage.

abstentionPrecision.name: বিরত থাকার নির্ভুলতা
abstentionPrecision.what: (বিরত থাকার নির্ভুলতা) When it declines, whether it was right to.

abstentionRecall.name: বিরত থাকার স্মরণ
abstentionRecall.what: (বিরত থাকার স্মরণ) Whether it answers the questions it should answer, rather than declining defensively.

jurisdictionPurity.name: এখতিয়ার বিশুদ্ধতা
jurisdictionPurity.what: (এখতিয়ার বিশুদ্ধতা) Whether any answer mixes the Indian position with another jurisdiction's.

authorityPurity.name: কর্তৃপক্ষের বিশুদ্ধতা
authorityPurity.what: (কর্তৃপক্ষের বিশুদ্ধতা) Whether a filed or granted record ever appeared as a citation.

classificationAccuracy.name: শ্রেণিবিন্যাস নির্ভুলতা
classificationAccuracy.what: (শ্রেণিবিন্যাস নির্ভুলতা) Whether the product class the flow reaches is the right one.

multilingualQuality.name: বহুভাষিক গুণমান
multilingualQuality.what: Whether an answer in Telugu is as good as the same answer in English, judged by a speaker.

latency.name: বিলম্বিত সময়
latency.what: How long an answer takes, at the median and at the tail.

citationGroundedness.name: উদ্ধৃতি ভিত্তি
citationGroundedness.what: (উদ্ধৃতি ভিত্তি) Whether every citation points at a passage that was actually retrieved for that question. Narrower than citation correctness, and unlike it, checkable by a machine.

citationCoverage.name: উদ্ধৃতি কভারেজ
citationCoverage.what: পরীক্ষার প্রশ্ন যে অন্তত একটি নথি আশা করে, উত্তর তা উদ্ধৃত করে কিনা।
citationCoverage.target: as high as the corpus allows

abstentionReason.name: বিরত থাকার কারণ
abstentionReason.what: (বিরত থাকার কারণ) When it declines, whether it declines for the right one of the five reasons rather than merely declining.

forbiddenClaims.name: নিষিদ্ধ দাবি
forbiddenClaims.what: (নিষিদ্ধ দাবি) Whether answers avoid the phrases each case forbids — novelty conclusions, outcome predictions, dosage.

languageDetection.name: ভাষা শনাক্তকরণ
languageDetection.what: (ভাষা শনাক্তকরণ) Whether the script a question is written in is identified. Devanagari cannot separate Hindi from Marathi, so either counts for either and the interface reports the ambiguity.

recordsOffered.name: প্রস্তাবিত রেকর্ড
recordsOffered.what: (প্রস্তাবিত রেকর্ড) Whether filed or granted records appear beside an answer when the question is about the kind of thing that gets filed.

recordsDoNotRescue.name: রেকর্ড রক্ষা করে না
recordsDoNotRescue.what: (রেকর্ড রক্ষা করে না) Where a record exists and the sources do not support an answer, whether the system still declines.

errors.name: ত্রুটিসমূহ
errors.what: (ত্রুটিসমূহ) Cases that raised rather than answering or declining.

evaluation.caveatTitle: What these numbers were measured against
